# Reproducible AI API stability evidence

> JSONL observations, success rate, P50/P95 latency and HTTP error distributions.

## Gemini 4 Argon launch (checked 2026-10-15)

AIFast [announced the listing](https://www.aifast.hk/api/status) of `gemini-4-argon` on 2026-10-14. The current [catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing) marks it `available: true` and lists `gemini` and `openai` protocols. The OpenAI-compatible Base URL is `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

[Google's model documentation](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon) describes Argon as a flagship reasoning model for complex software engineering, mathematics, science and multi-step agents. Its 1,048,576-token unified context budget is shared by input, thinking and output. This is not a promise of 1M output through the gateway; Google's long decode requires a dedicated workflow.

This is listing and catalog evidence, not an inference test or stability benchmark. No authenticated inference request was run for this update, and it supplies no Argon success rate, latency result or long-term SLA. Check the current console for pricing and limits, then test protocol features independently.

[Check an existing gateway with a temporary, low-limit key](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repository&utm_campaign=gemini-4-argon-launch&utm_content=stability-llms), then validate text, streaming and tools from your deployment network.

## Evidence rules

- Keep one raw request per JSONL line before summarizing.
- Record UTC time, exact model ID, region, network, status, elapsed time and request feature.
- Split text, streaming, tool-call and image workloads.
- Publish sample count, observation window, failure definition, P50/P95 and status distribution together.
- A smoke test is not a long-term availability result.

## Three distinct figures

- First-party product availability is an operator-published metric.
- Test-window success rate describes declared samples and conditions.
- Contractual SLA is defined by service terms and remedies.

These figures must not be substituted for one another. The bundled JSONL is synthetic format data, not AIFast production monitoring.
